statement.p: Find positive numbers a and b so that the change of variables s=ax, t=by transforms the integral \int\int_R \,dx\,dy into \int\int_T \left\vert \frac{\partial(x,y)}{\partial(s,t)}\right\vert \,ds\,dt for the region R, the rectangle 0\le x \le 60, 0\le y \le 75 and the region T, the square 0\le s, t \le 1.

static.solution:
T is defined by the inequalities 0 \le s = ax \le 1 \qquad 0\le t=by\le 1 that correspond to the inequalities 0\le x \le 1/a = 60 \qquad 0\le y \le 1/b = 75 that define R. Thus a=1/60 and b=1/75.
Then, we have x = 60 s and y = 75 t, so \left\vert \frac{\partial(x,y)}{\partial(s,t)}\right\vert = \left|\begin{array}{cc} 60 \amp 0 \\ 0 \amp 75 \end{array}\right| = 4500.
